Exactly four isolated full plant sprites arranged in a generous 2 by 2 grid on TRUE transparent alpha background, ideally 2048 by 2048 pixels. LOWER LEFT: Sugar bush (Rhus ovata), dense rounded large shrub with visible reddish young branch forks, broad leathery oval olive green leaves characteristically folded along midrib; subtle tiny pale spring clusters only as accent. Remove ALL the huge flat gray-green scalloped leaf shapes that currently form a solid backing screen across the top and sides. They are botanically wrong. Replace that entire solid backing with open transparent air containing thousands of fine delicate narrow threadlike branching gray-green leaves, each a few pixels wide, separated by visible little holes of empty alpha. Every foliage spray must be like wispy filiform Artemisia californica foliage: needle-thin split threads, much finer than rosemary, no flat fan leaves and no fern fronds. The outer perimeter must be made of sparse tiny twigs and extremely fine needle-thin foliage tips, with many tiny see-through gaps. Let woody stems show between delicate wispy sprays throughout the crown. A natural airy delicate lacework of extremely thin silver-green threads on branching brown stems. No large solid leaf silhouettes anywhere. Keep full plant including roots and every tip inside at least 8 percent empty alpha margin. Do not add text, UI, background, animals or cast shadow. Single complete transparent production pixel-art sprite.
